## Survey open-0: LIN-4462 @ 302edafc3

**Why it will be difficult.** The repeat itself is mechanical. The kit (`docs/plans/survey/area-read.md`, blob `cbec2d84`) and reader prompt (`area-read-reader-prompt.md`, blob `ef1c2ca9`) are unchanged at BASE, and the hash rule picks the same 14 paths per area as at `4b5001ddf`. The difficulty is that the comparison no longer measures what it promised:

1. **The control is not untouched.** 4 of 14 sampled `front-end-pages` files changed (`render-swipe`, `render-session`, `render-task-page`, `render-proxy`), plus the tracked `render-task-timeline`. `render-task-page.js` was changed by LIN-4460, piece 1 of LIN-4447 itself, so part of the control's Δ is the treatment. Kit verdict 4 says flag it, not swap it; LIN-4463's adoption had already ruled this control out as untouched for its own window. D = ΔRuns − Δcontrol is biased by an unknown amount.
2. **Noise vs threshold.** Baseline passes were 3.3/3.0 (Runs) and 3.3/3.5 (control). A ±0.5 threshold on two one-decimal passes sits near the noise floor. Only 3 sampled Runs files changed (`cost-read`, `digest-feedback`, `wall-clock-summary`); 1 of 13 planned files is sampled. "No detectable difference" is the likeliest result, and says little.
3. **The rubric leans on the work.** K2's frozen examples (close-out, PRs per task, which model a dispatch used) are exactly the rules LIN-4460 and LIN-4454 consolidated. A K2 rise is partly the rubric asking about the fixed rules. State it; don't edit.
4. **The Runs note grew** 11,540 → 18,045 B (Waiting 20 → 21; control 6,404 → 7,115). Scored apart, but the bundle is ~6.5 KB larger.
5. **Mechanics.** Same window is easy: one commit, one batch of four. Fresh general-purpose agents can be launched. But the baseline never recorded its model ("inherited the operator's model"), so sameness can't be verified; record it this time. Follow `area-read-method-as-run.md` §8 exactly: one added inputs line, exactly four readers, combined score = mean of the one-decimal pass means, Lessons bytes from the guard.
6. **Trigger.** BASE is "piece 8, PR 2". From the repo I can't confirm piece 8 has fully landed.

**Stop-and-report.** Nothing at BASE forces a rule or rubric change: blobs match, samples are stable, and the `areas.json` edits don't move them. The moved control is handled by the kit's flag. Substituting a control would be a new kit, so stop and report rather than do it.

**Symptom of something deeper.** The kit's own Known limits say most of the move lies outside Runs and the sample barely touches the planned files. With a partly treated control and four readers, this measures area-at-large drift, not whether LIN-4447's pieces worked. This read is a weak signal at best.

**What I'd do first.** Confirm piece 8 is the last piece and has landed; verify both blob SHAs at the after-commit; write the control-moved flag (naming LIN-4460) and the K2 caveat into the reports *before* any reader runs, so the result can't be reinterpreted afterwards. Then launch exactly four readers in one batch and record the model.

## Survey global: LIN-4462 @ 302edafc3

**Where it lands.** No code changes. The task lands on LIN-4447's trail and in `docs/plans/survey/`. The kit (`area-read.md`, blob `cbec2d84`) and the reader prompt (`ef1c2ca9`) are unchanged at `302edafc3`. The heading is now code: `area-read` is a row in `COMMENT_KINDS` (`lib/run-trail.js:140`, landing `none`). So the kit's "never a PR URL" rule is now a backstop, and the code is what keeps a report out of the landing.

**What the instrument will see.** I re-ran the kit's snippet at both commits:

- **Runs**: 115 → 121 files, and 34 of them changed (+1,589/−1,270 lines). The sample still holds the same 14 paths. **11 are byte-identical.** Only `cost-read.js`, `wall-clock-summary.js` and `digest-feedback.js` moved, all three getting smaller. None of the six new homes ranks in the first 14 (`run-trail.js`, `run-live-wait.js`, `item-stage-stamp.js`, `dispatch-feedback-kinds.js`, `cost-read-calls.js`, `usage-snapshot-intake.js`). The paired set is the full sample.
- **Control** `front-end-pages`: 92 → 94 files, the same 14 paths. **4 sampled blobs changed**: `render-swipe` (LIN-4446), `render-session` (LIN-4472), `render-task-page` (LIN-4446/4472/4460), `render-proxy` (LIN-4457/4471). 3 of the 4 tracked files changed too. Verdict 4 fires. The changes are small (−54 to +140 bytes each).
- **Runs note**: 11,540 → 18,045 bytes. Waiting went 20 → 21, and Lessons went 4,268 → **6,019 of 6,144** (guard figure). Known limit 3 ("the note … shrinks") turned out false. The note grew.

**Done the obvious way**, the task runs four readers over Runs code that is mostly identical and posts a D. With 11/14 Runs files unchanged, D is mostly reader variance, set against a ±0.5 threshold. This is the symptom-level point. The parent's third Done-when asks a question this frozen kit can barely see. An honest result here is "no detectable difference; the sample did not reach the work", not a pass or a fail. The comparison should say that in its first line.

**What it would leave in two places.** The baseline pair is committed (`area-read-reports/*-4b5001ddf.md`, plus `area-read-method-as-run.md`). LIN-4463 committed its after-pair and an adoption note in the same way. If the reports go only onto LIN-4447, the repo keeps a baseline with no partner, and the result lives only on a ticket. Nothing would notice, because no registry lists these reports.

**Better, and within this task's reach:**
- Commit the two after-reports as `*-302edafc3.md` (or whatever the after-commit is), next to the baselines. Add a short comparison addendum, the way LIN-4463 did, and leave the kit unedited.
- State the sample's blind spot as numbers: 3/14 Runs files changed, 34/121 in the area.
- Use the free noise reference. `front-end-pages` was already read with the same manifest at `e8e92d50a` (LIN-4464), when only 3 files had moved, each by tens of bytes. Two independent control reads of almost the same code show how big reader drift is next to the 0.5 threshold.
- Add no Lesson. There are 125 bytes of headroom. The Waiting entries this piece settles: none.

**Better still, but not this task's:**
- A new, named kit that samples the files the pieces actually touched.
- A fix for the frozen kit's now-stale prose: the Citations rationale, and known limits 1 and 3.
- Restricting readers' tools (method §8).
- The Runs note's growth, and `dispatch-store.js` growing again (248.5 → 250.5 KB). These belong to the parent's close-out, which shouldn't rely on this read to show them.

## Grounding (beat 1): after-read set at `302edafc3`, before any reader runs

**AFTER commit: `302edafc3`** (`302edafc3a27a8d0d64a88435766625ab8d24cb5`, LIN-4475 squash, "piece 8, PR 2"). It is still `origin/main` after a fresh fetch. Piece 8 is complete: LIN-4474 (SD #340) and LIN-4476 (SD #341) are the simple-dispatcher PRs, and LIN-4475 is the last LinearViewer PR. LIN-4461's close-out and review comments say both mains are green and nothing landed after. LIN-4453 to LIN-4461 and the subtasks LIN-4474, 4475 and 4476 are all **Done**. Both areas are read from git objects at this commit.

**Frozen instrument, verified at `302edafc3`:** kit `area-read.md` = `cbec2d848d63e18a0a0bdd6d5ed17307dcde6c26` ✓. Reader prompt = `ef1c2ca9173831f53ca32b60da1d805d27bf2159` ✓. No commit since the ticket was filed touched the kit, the reader prompt or `area-read-method-as-run.md`. The kit's snippet was copied to a file and diffed against the kit: identical. `areas.json` moved (`d13fca20e` → `a4f33893e`), but the sampled paths did not.

**Samples (kit snippet, N = 14):** the same 14 paths as the baseline in both areas.
- Runs & dispatch: universe 115 → 121, sample 199,552 → 196,308 B. 11 blobs unchanged. Changed: `lib/cost-read.js` (LIN-4454, LIN-4457), `lib/digest-feedback.js` (LIN-4455) and `lib/wall-clock-summary.js` (LIN-4455). Paired set = full sample (14/14).
- Control `front-end-pages`: universe 92 → 94, sample 206,530 → 206,753 B. 10 blobs unchanged. Changed: `lib/render-swipe.js` (LIN-4446), `lib/render-session.js` (LIN-4472), `lib/render-task-page.js` (LIN-4446, LIN-4472, **LIN-4460**) and `lib/render-proxy.js` (LIN-4471, **LIN-4457 leftovers**). Tracked files: `render-task-timeline.js` changed (LIN-4472), and `render-run-evidence.js` is unchanged. Paired set 14/14.

**Notes (guard's `lessonsBytes`, run via `area-notes.test.js` at the AFTER commit):** Runs note 11,540 → 18,045 B, Lessons 4,268 → 6,019 of 6,144, Waiting 20 → 21. Control note 6,404 → 7,115 B, Lessons 1,023 → 1,023, Waiting 14 → 14.

**Caveats fixed now, before readers (they go into the reports as written):**
1. **Control moved, kit verdict 4 fires.** 4 of 14 sampled control blobs changed, and 1 of the 2 unsampled tracked files changed. Two of the changes come from LIN-4447's own pieces: LIN-4460 (`render-task-page.js`) and LIN-4457 leftovers (`render-proxy.js`). So part of Δcontrol is treatment, and D is biased by an unknown amount. The control is flagged, not substituted.
2. **K2 leans on the work.** K2's frozen examples (close-out, PRs per task, which model a dispatch used) are the rules LIN-4460, LIN-4458 and LIN-4454 consolidated. A K2 rise is partly the rubric asking about the fixed rules.
3. **Coverage.** 3 of 14 sampled Runs files changed, against 34 of 121 in the area. None of the new homes (`run-trail.js`, `run-live-wait.js`, `cost-read-calls.js`, `dispatch-feedback-kinds.js`, …) is sampled. With 11 of 14 Runs blobs identical, D is mostly reader variance against a ±0.5 threshold.
4. **Model.** Readers are general-purpose agents with no model override. They inherit the operator's model, recorded as `claude-opus-5-5`. The baseline's model was not recorded, so whether the two runs used the same model cannot be checked.

**In flight:** open PR #2446 (LIN-4468 notes, not a LIN-4447 piece) adds one Waiting entry to `docs/areas/runs-and-dispatch.md`, and touches no Lessons and no sampled file. Because the read is pinned to `302edafc3`, a merge does not change it. Three stale open PRs (#2185, #1074, #963, last updated Jul–Oct) touch unsampled Runs files.

**Bundles:** built per method §2, outside the repository. The builder reproduces the baseline bundles byte-for-byte at `4b5001ddf` (211,623 / 213,452 B). AFTER bundles: Runs 214,884 B, control 214,386 B, each the only file in its directory. Branch `feat/lin-4462-area-reads-after` is cut from `302edafc3`, with no commits yet.

**Stop-and-report: nothing forces a rule or rubric change.**

## Run summary: LIN-4462 after-read, four beats

**PR:** https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2449 (open, unmerged), branch `feat/lin-4462-area-reads-after`, head `10dedc4fe5127f3cc63f830109d826cd5c2b391e`. It contains one docs-only commit, `10dedc4fe`, on `302edafc3`. **CI:** all 8 checks pass on that exact head: unit, unit-proxy, E2E 1–4, secret scan, `CI success` (Actions run 43545243556).

**What it adds:** `docs/plans/survey/area-read-reports/runs-and-dispatch-302edafc3.md`, `front-end-pages-302edafc3.md` and `comparison-302edafc3-vs-4b5001ddf.md`, placed beside the baselines. The kit (`cbec2d84`), reader prompt (`ef1c2ca9`), method file, sampling rule, baselines and area notes are unchanged. No Lessons were added. **Retires: nothing** (a measurement).

**On LIN-4447**, three new comments, each read back after posting (heading present, body identical):
- `5c146c4b-776f-4438-a165-944ca20a81fd`: `## Area read: Runs & dispatch @ 302edafc3`
- `91473853-1119-4cb3-ac3d-4c7987472c54`: `## Area read: Front end: server-rendered pages @ 302edafc3`
- `a2280347-29fc-4b9f-8eb4-6a7ca8117fd6`: `## Area read comparison: after @ 302edafc3 vs baseline @ 4b5001ddf`, which ends with the "Recorded for the parent close-out:" line

All three classify as `area-read` under `commentKindOf` (`lib/run-trail.js`), checked before posting. The comparison's PR link therefore joins no landing. No existing comment and no description was edited.

**Result:** Runs code 3.15 → 3.30 (+0.15) and control 3.40 → 3.30 (−0.10), so **D = +0.25: no detectable difference at the kit's ±0.5 threshold.** The noise guard passed in all four reads, and the control-moved flag is raised (LIN-4460 and LIN-4457 are among the control's changes). Notes: Runs 3.25 → 3.50 and control 3.00 → 3.50, reported apart. Honest reading: 11 of 14 sampled Runs files are byte-identical and none of the six new homes is sampled, and D is two single-point changes by single readers, within the drift the `e8e92d50a` control read shows. The frozen sample could not show the work either way.

**Beats run:**
1. Grounding: AFTER commit `302edafc3`, piece 8 and every LIN-4447 piece Done, both blob SHAs verified, the same 14 paths per area, bundles reproduced byte-exact. Flags pre-registered in `7305f073`.
2. Four fresh general-purpose readers on `claude-opus-5-5`, launched in one batch, all clean under the method §5 check. They used Bash on their own inputs only and ran outside the repo working directory.
3. Scoring, the reports and the comparison, committed as `10dedc4fe`. Local tests: `area-notes`, `docs-architecture-anchor-resolver` and `lin-4458-comment-kind-census` 212/0, `docs-architecture-links` 8/0.
4. PR, CI, the posts above and this summary.

**What holds:** the reports and comparison, committed and posted. The verdict as the kit's rules produce it, with no rule, rubric or kit edited. **What is left (not this session's):** review and merge of the PR, and LIN-4462's close-out; LIN-4462 is not set to Done here. Whether this result satisfies LIN-4447's third Done-when is John's call at the parent close-out. No scratch worktrees were created, so none needed cleaning.

## Review — LIN-4462

Reviewed PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2449 at head `10dedc4fe5127f3cc63f830109d826cd5c2b391e`: one docs-only commit on `302edafc3`, adding 3 files under `docs/plans/survey/area-read-reports/`.

CI: green. All 8 checks pass on `10dedc4fe` (Actions run 43545243556): unit, unit-proxy, E2E 1–4, secret scan, CI success.

### Against what was asked
- *"Repeat piece 0 unchanged after piece 8 lands."* **Met.** `302edafc3` is still `origin/main`, and nothing has landed after it. I checked the frozen instrument myself. At `302edafc3` and at the PR head, the kit is `cbec2d84…` and the reader prompt is `ef1c2ca9…`, both matching the baseline. The method file is unchanged by this PR. No commit between `4b5001ddf` and `302edafc3` touched the kit or the prompt; the only commits there are the LIN-4453, 4463 and 4464 report and baseline commits.
- *"Fresh agents, same committed sampling rule and rubric (no edits)."* **Met.** I re-ran the kit's snippet, extracted from `area-read.md` itself, at both commits:
  - Runs: 115 → 121 files, and the same 14 paths (199,552 → 196,308 B). The changed sampled blobs are exactly `cost-read`, `digest-feedback` and `wall-clock-summary`.
  - Control: 92 → 94 files, the same 14 paths (206,530 → 206,753 B). The changed sampled blobs are exactly `render-swipe`, `render-session`, `render-task-page` and `render-proxy`.
  - Area-wide counts: Runs 29 changed + 6 new = 35, control 14 + 2 = 16. All of these match the reports.
  - Fresh readers: I can't verify this independently (see the ledger). The agent IDs and model are recorded.
- *"Runs & dispatch plus the untouched control front-end-pages, read in the same window."* **Met, with the flag the kit requires.** One commit, one batch of four. The control is not untouched, and verdict 4 is raised, naming LIN-4460 and LIN-4457. This flag was pre-registered in `7305f073` before any reader ran, and no control was substituted. That is right under the kit.
- *"Post both reports on LIN-4447 under `## Area read` (never `## Blind read`)."* **Met.** Comments `5c146c4b` and `91473853` exist on LIN-4447 and open with `## Area read: …`. I ran `commentKindOf` (`lib/run-trail.js`) on the posted bodies, and all three comments classify as `area-read` (landing `none`).
- *"Add a comparison against the baseline reports… whether Runs improved by more than the control did."* **Met.** I recomputed the comparison from the baseline files:
  - Runs: 3.3/3.0 → 3.3/3.3, so 3.15 → 3.30. Control: 3.3/3.5 → 3.3/3.3, so 3.40 → 3.30.
  - D = +0.15 − (−0.10) = **+0.25**, inside ±0.5, so the kit's verdict is "no detectable difference".
  - The per-criterion attribution checks out: Runs pass B's K2 went 2 → 3, and control pass B's K3 went 4 → 3.
  - The `e8e92d50a` reference is used correctly. It scored 4 3 3 3 / 4 3 3 3, matching the after-read.
- *"Record the comparison on the parent so the close-out can cite it."* **Met.** Comment `a2280347` is on LIN-4447 and carries the "Recorded for the parent close-out:" line.
- *"Retires: nothing."* **Met.** The PR and the run summary both say "Retires: nothing". No `docs/areas/*` file is touched (the runs-and-dispatch and front-end-pages note blobs are identical at base and head), so the Lessons byte cap is untouched. There is no separate `### Leftovers` comment, but the ticket names nothing to retire, so nothing is missing.
- *Binding constraints* (readiness from the trail, no provider reads, prompt changelog): not engaged. The change is docs only.

### Regression / class / tests
- **Regression:** three new files with no history. No reverted change is re-applied.
- **Isolated or one of a class:** isolated. It is a one-off measurement, and the sibling after-reads (LIN-4463) follow the same pattern.
- **Test level and mutation check:** no tests were added, and none are owed for a docs-only measurement. The one behaviour the deliverable relies on is that a report link joins no landing. I checked that directly by running `commentKindOf` on the real posted bodies, as above, rather than by a mutation.
- **Area notes:** `docs/plans/survey/` is unmapped in `areas.json`, and no Lesson binds this work.
- **Rulings:** none open or resolved for LIN-4462.
- **Small observation, not a defect:** the survey said 34 changed Runs files and the reports say 35. The reports already reconcile this: 35 counts changed plus new by blob, and my count agrees.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **Reader outputs are genuine fresh-agent outputs, unprompted by the work** (inside: it is the measurement itself). CI cannot see the agent transcripts, and neither can I. They are recorded by agent ID (`a015db58…`, `aa55222e…`, `afc37738…`, `af9a8df7…`), alongside a contamination table. Settled **before the merge** only on the record: the reports' internal arithmetic, sample lists and blob SHAs all reproduce. The verbatim outputs are not independently reproducible, and re-running readers would be a new read, not a check. Close-out does nothing here beyond noting it is accepted on the record.
- **Same model as baseline** (inside). This cannot be verified: the baseline never recorded its model. It is disclosed in both reports and the comparison, so it is discharged by disclosure. Nothing is left to settle.
- **Whether this result satisfies LIN-4447's third Done-when** (outside this ticket: it is the parent's close-out judgment, and LIN-4462's acceptance asks only for the reads and the comparison). The home is LIN-4447's close-out, where the question is already raised as a decision for John. No ticket is needed.

### Verdict
Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger

Every acceptance sentence is met, and the frozen instrument, samples and arithmetic all reproduce independently. For close-out: re-check CI on `10dedc4fe`, then merge #2449. Nothing needs fixing. The ledger's first two items need no action beyond noting them, and the third belongs to LIN-4447.

## Blind read
Verdict: same. Nothing got better or worse: every file the change touches (three new reports under `docs/plans/survey/area-read-reports/`) is in an excluded path, so the readable diff `git diff 302edafc3 10dedc4fe` with the exclusions is empty, and no code, test or how-to doc differs between the two commits.

Read: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2449 at `10dedc4fe` against `302edafc3`.

### Inside the area, fix-sized
None.

### Inside the area, larger
None.

### Outside the area
None.

## Close-out — LIN-4462

**What merged:** PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2449, squash-merged as `a886fb50691383b02cd230d4dfd685aca6b4a9b4`, pinned with `--match-head-commit 10dedc4fe5127f3cc63f830109d826cd5c2b391e`. It adds three docs-only files under `docs/plans/survey/area-read-reports/`: the Runs & dispatch report, the `front-end-pages` report, and the comparison against the `4b5001ddf` baseline. All three are on `main` (checked on the merge commit). Nothing is retired, as asked.

**How it meets the ask:** I rely on review's account (comment `5eae045e`), which found every acceptance sentence met. The reports and comparison are on LIN-4447 (`5c146c4b`, `91473853`, `a2280347`), and all three classify as `area-read`. Result: Runs 3.15 → 3.30, control 3.40 → 3.30, D = +0.25, which is no detectable difference at the frozen ±0.5 threshold. The control moved (LIN-4460, LIN-4457) and is flagged, not substituted.

**Changes I made:** none. Review asked for no fixes, and the blind read (`0c7de5ed`, verdict same) found nothing in any category.

**CI:** all 8 checks passed on the exact head `10dedc4fe` before the merge (unit, unit-proxy, E2E 1–4, secret scan, CI success; Actions run 43545243556). The PR was MERGEABLE and CLEAN, and `main` was still `302edafc3`. No CI re-run was needed, as I changed no commit.

**Ledger:**
- *Reader outputs are genuine fresh-agent outputs (inside):* accepted on the record, as review specified. Agent IDs and the contamination table are recorded, and the arithmetic, samples and blob SHAs reproduce. Re-running readers would be a new measurement, so I did not.
- *Same model as baseline (inside):* discharged by disclosure. The baseline never recorded its model, and this run recorded `claude-opus-5-5`.
- *Whether this satisfies LIN-4447's third Done-when (outside):* it stays with LIN-4447's close-out as John's call, as review recorded. No ticket was filed.

**Deploy / post-deploy:** none. The change is docs-only and has no runtime effect, and the files are verified on `main`.

**Follow-ups:** none filed. Review and the blind read raised no outside finds, and no area note changed. Related tickets: LIN-4447 stays open, since its close-out is a separate decision.

**Archive & prune:** the pre-prune snapshot was verified in `/snapshots` (captured 2026-11-14T02:26:20Z). The description below `## As asked` is now a stub, with `## Size of the move` kept verbatim.

description:
## As asked

**Parent:** LIN-4447 (Runs & dispatch, left simpler). The parent's scope is its `## As asked` block. Its approved design and plan are the `## Design` and `## Implementation Plan` sections of the parent description, and the Design comment (6efb91fa) holds the full analysis. **Start from the parent's approved plan and follow it. Where the code shows it is wrong, change course and say so in a comment on LIN-4447.**
**Repository:** JKershaw/LinearViewer. **Grounding commit:** `origin/main` 4b5001ddf. On 2026-11-13 at 14:00Z it was still HEAD, with nothing landed since the ticket was filed.

## Piece 0, repeated after the last piece

**What:** repeat piece 0 unchanged after piece 8 lands. Use fresh agents, the same committed sampling rule and rubric (no edits), and Runs & dispatch plus the untouched control `front-end-pages`, read in the same window.

**Acceptance:**

* Post both reports on LIN-4447 under `## Area read` (never `## Blind read`).
* Add a comparison against the baseline reports. The parent's Done-when clause asks whether Runs improved by more than the control did.
* Record the comparison on the parent so the close-out can cite it.

**Retires:** nothing (this is a measurement).

Session fit: fits one session
Plan-review due: no — covered by LIN-4447's approving plan-review (comment 12619798-1986-467f-b67c-8bed766a7813, rev 2)

**Binding for every piece (from the parent's Constraints):** compute readiness from the trail on read and never store it. Add no GitHub or provider reads. In the same change, remove the Waiting entries this piece settles and any stale Lesson clause in `docs/areas/runs-and-dispatch.md`, and keep Lessons under 6,144 bytes. Say in the PR what this piece retires. Never recompute stored pre-cutover history, and never edit recorded prompt changelog text. The LLM & prompts side of the seam belongs to LIN-4448 (A14).

*End of what was asked. Steps write below this line; nothing above it changes.*

## Size of the move

**Size:** just the task
**Why:** Repeats the frozen paired read once at the final commit and posts both reports and an honest comparison on the parent; no Survey finding binds, since the frozen kit already flags the moved control and sample blind spot.
**Cuts:** none
**Decided by:** the standing policy

## Outcome (stub, pruned at close-out)

Implemented as asked, with no deviation from the parent's plan: the frozen paired area read was repeated at `302edafc3` (four fresh readers, `claude-opus-5-5`), and both reports plus the comparison were posted on LIN-4447 (comments `5c146c4b`, `91473853`, `a2280347`). PR #2449 ([https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2449](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2449>)) merged as `a886fb506`, adding three docs-only files under `docs/plans/survey/area-read-reports/`. Result: D = +0.25, no detectable difference at the frozen ±0.5 threshold. Retires: nothing. Full history is preserved in the task snapshots and the comment trail.
